stemMd: A reservoir is 3/5 full. Adding 120 litres makes it 4/5 full. What is its capacity?
explanationMd: The addition changes fullness by 4/5−3/5=1/5. Thus one fifth of capacity is 120 litres and the whole capacity is 120×5=600 litres.

distractorRationale.d: This treats the added fraction as one half instead of one fifth.
distractorRationale.c: This multiplies by the final numerator rather than the fraction difference.
distractorRationale.a: This divides by four fifths, which is not the added fraction.
distractorRationale.e: This adds an extra 120 after finding capacity.
